class.name: CbCurve
class.brief_description: A curve a rules sheet's motion reads by this node's name: a falloff, a ramp, a shape over time.
class.description: Put it in the scene of the sheet (under the node the [CbRules] is under) and name it; a motion block's numbers read it as [code]curve(Name, x)[/code]: [code]impulse 9 * curve(Falloff, reach) along away[/code], [code]force 40 * curve(Ramp, time / 0.3) along look[/code]. The bake writes it into the motions file as 64 values at even steps over the curve's domain, so every machine reads the same; between two of them it is read in a straight line, and past its ends it holds the end's value.

members.member: The curve, drawn in the inspector's curve editor. Its domain is what [code]x[/code] runs over (0 to 1 by default: what [code]reach[/code] is).
